Grubhub Create Proxy Courier Phone Number

params.name: merchant_long_id
params.description: The long-form unique identifier for the merchant on Grubhub.

items.docs: Generates a masked proxy phone number that creates a bridge between the merchant's phone number and the courier's phone number. This protects both parties' actual phone numbers while enabling direct communication. Best practice is to call this endpoint as needed rather than caching the result.
